request: Pull the last 30 days of CVEs from the NIST NVD REST v2 API (published 2026-06-15 through 2026-07-14). Flatten each vulnerability's id, publication date, description, CVSS v3.1 base score + severity, primary CWE, and enrich with cvss_band (Critical/High/Medium/Low), days_since_published, and trend analysis by cvss_band + severity. Publish to 'Prep Agent / 12 - NIST NVD Vulnerabilities' on Tableau Server for vulnerability management analysts.

sources.name: NIST NVD CVE Feed (30 days)
sources.description: National Vulnerability Database v2 API, /rest/json/cves/2.0. Public, keyless (rate-limited but usable). One row per CVE published in the trailing 30-day window. Response envelope: {resultsPerPage, startIndex, totalResults, format, version, vulnerabilities: [{cve: {id, published, descriptions[], metrics.cvssMetricV31[0].cvssData.{baseScore, baseSeverity, attackVector}, weaknesses[]}]}. Pagination: offset via startIndex + resultsPerPage cap of 2000; NVD tags the total in totalResults so the walker can terminate cleanly.

args.name: NVD Trend
args.features_description: Adds row-level temporal features parsed from published (year, month, quarter, day_of_week, iso_week). Row-level CVE detail.
args.stats_description: Long-form CVE statistics (one row per dimension x value x year x month over CVSS severity band and attack vector). Includes daily_count, 7-day rolling counts, YoY deltas (limited for a 30-day window), z-score anomalies vs baseline (|z|>=2.0 flagged is_anomaly=True). Use to spot severity-band spikes or exploitation-vector drift over the window.

outputs.name: NVD Vulnerability Detail
outputs.description: Row-level CVEs from the NIST National Vulnerability Database, trailing 30-day window (published 2026-06-15 through 2026-07-14). Includes cve_id, published, last_modified, vuln_status, description (first English description), cvss_v31_base (numeric 0-10), cvss_v31_sev (LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH/CRITICAL), attack_vector (NETWORK/ADJACENT/LOCAL/PHYSICAL), primary_cwe (first weakness description), source_id, days_since_published. Plus calendar features. Source: services.nvd.nist.gov/rest/json/cves/2.0. Refresh: daily.

outputs.name: NVD Vulnerability Stats
outputs.description: Long-form CVE trend statistics (one row per dimension x value x year x month over CVSS severity band and attack vector). Includes 7-day rolling counts, z-score anomalies (|z|>=2.0 flagged is_anomaly=True), lifetime rank/pct_of_total. Joinable from Tableau on (dimension, value, year, month). Use to identify unusual clusters of CRITICAL-severity CVEs or a sudden shift in attack-vector distribution across the window.
